baseline: Current SN1_H1 after the split-date ATR correction: separate High/Low Ridge with the existing five directional features, fixed score mapping/source separation/side-specific smoothing, and official portfolio accounting. Two current-code reconstructions and the saved DM-20260930-02 SN1_H1 score must match bit for bit before candidate fitting.
train_window: Train only, 2008-11-04 through 2016-03-31; expanding evaluation folds 2011 through 2016 (2016-01-01 through 2016-03-31 is partial)

confirmation_policy: All Train dates and the UPSTATE=1,x<0 attribution have already been inspected and are known development history, not independent OOS evidence. No Valid target, raw target, Valid evaluation, Freeze, or external submission. If either current-code baseline reproduction fails, stop before candidate fitting. No post-result rescue or tuning.

trials.comparison: Current SN1_H1 versus the same annual expanding High/Low Ridge and score route with only UP_PULLBACK added as a sixth feature

feature_definitions.added_feature_only: UP_PULLBACK = I(event_upstate == 1) * max(0, -event_box_position), exactly reusing the causal Event-Box implementation. event_box_position x = 2*(Close-Lower)/(Upper-Lower)-1 while the existing Event-Box state is BOX; otherwise it is missing. The UPSTATE and Box boundaries are the existing signal-date as-of states.

model: H1: separate High and Low expanding Ridge models on existing breakout-event rows; High target is positive date-wise centered H1 residual rank, Low target is its negative. Candidate uses the same five baseline columns in the same order plus UP_PULLBACK as column six. Missing feature handling, standardization, score mapping, side-source separation, side-specific smoothing, official quintiles and portfolio weights follow the current SN1_H1 route.
selection_rule: Primary gates: strictly positive pooled 2011-2016 delta Mean RankIC, annualized gross return, and daily Q5-Q1. Any nonpositive primary gate means REJECT. SUPPORT additionally requires positive direction for all three gates when excluding partial 2016 and no material Long/Short cancellation, turnover/cost-only explanation, or attribution-direction conflict; mixed secondary evidence with primary gates passed is recorded MIXED. No threshold/model changes or follow-on candidate after results.
